strahd_watcher.prompt: The first time the party leaves the village of Barovia escorting Ireena Kolyana west along the Old Svalich Road, Strahd von Zarovich watches them from a ridge. Low camera on the road looking up past the travellers toward the ridge. Foreground, seen from behind and a little to one side: four small travellers walking the muddy road between dead, twisted trees, cloaked and hooded adventurers whose faces we cannot see (one in plate armour with a sword on the back, one holding up a lantern that throws warm orange light across the mud and the trunks, one hooded with a staff). With them walks Ireena, drawn exactly as the second reference image shows her: long wavy auburn hair, a cream scarf, a dark plum cloak over a blue-grey laced dress, brown boots. She has stopped and turned her head to look up at the ridge, afraid. Above them, high on a bare rocky ridge against a cold, moonlit, cloud-torn sky, Strahd sits perfectly still on a huge, powerful black warhorse whose eyes glow like banked coals. Strahd is drawn exactly as the first reference image shows him: pale gaunt face, slicked black hair, a black high-collared coat with silver frogging, a long black cape lined in blood red, its high red collar standing up; one gloved hand rests on the reins and he looks down at the road, patient and amused. He and his horse are a sharp, clearly readable silhouette rimmed by cold moonlight, the cape stirring in the wind. Far behind him, tiny and faint on a distant cliff in the mist, the spires of Castle Ravenloft with one red-lit window. Grey-green mist pools in the hollows along the road. 16:9 widescreen.

death_house_cult.prompt: A low vaulted dungeon chamber under an old townhouse; a ring of tall hooded figures made of black smoke and shadow stand around a stone altar, faces hidden, all turned inward, chanting. death_house_lorghoth.prompt: Low camera from the floor of a vaulted crypt looking up: Lorghoth the Decayer heaves upright, a towering hunched heap of grey-brown rot, black mould and sickly green, scraps of black cult robes, bones and candle stubs caught in it, its top scraping the vault, two small sickly-green eyes over a sagging mouth. death_house_children.prompt: A narrow crypt gallery under the house; two small stone slabs newly closed, candle stubs on them. castle_glimpse.prompt: From the muddy western edge of the village of Barovia, past two leaning posts and the last grey, nail-shuttered cottages, the view opens across a misty gorge to Castle Ravenloft: black spires on a sheer pillar of rock a thousand feet high, its towers lost in low cloud, a single high window lit a deep red. {party}, small at the left edge; a crow on a post. madam_eva_reading.prompt: Inside a great patched tent lit purple and amber, a high close camera over a low round table draped in wine-red cloth: five painted fortune cards laid in a cross, four face down and one face up showing an ornate painted figure with no lettering, Madam Eva's thin brown hands with gold bangles laid flat beside them. bonegrinder_view.prompt: From the edge of a bare rock crag, the valley of Barovia opens below under a lid of grey cloud: the Svalich road winding between dark pines, the grey roofs and a few chimney threads of a small village, a rutted lane winding up toward the crag, and far off on its pillar of rock a castle with one red window, looking back. mordenkainen_jar.prompt: A cold one-room mountain hut, a game board furred with frost on the table, every piece black.
